meta.title: Improve role+name filter performance on Windows
meta.body_summary: Introduce a two-phase depth-limited search for Windows UI element lookup: shallow depth‑15 pass first, falling back to depth‑50 if not found, to reduce average latency without losing accuracy.

perf_labels.notes: Two-phase search introduced a timeout double‑counting bug; bot review flagged it, PR closed without fix or any performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 85 changed lines in a single file, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step performance PR but was closed due to a correctness bug, not because of its size or scope.

review_details.concern_detail: The two-phase search applies the specified timeout_ms to each phase independently, causing the total search duration to exceed the intended timeout by up to double. This violates the expected timeout contract.
review_details.performance_claim: Faster element lookups by first scanning only to depth 15, falling back to a deep scan when nothing is found.
review_details.rejection_signals: Bot review identified a timeout double-counting defect; no human review or additional commits occurred; PR closed without merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent introduced a subtle contract violation by failing to propagate a single timeout value across a two‑phase search. Handling temporal resource bounds across algorithm stages requires deeper awareness of API semantics.

detection_detail.code_reading: cursor bugbot analyzed the timeout propagation logic and flagged the per‑phase usage of timeout_ms, exposing that total duration could double the intended bound.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after metrics provided; the PR offers only a narrative claim.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After the bot review, no further commits were made; the PR was closed (presumably by the author) without addressing the timeout bug.

core_change_summary.description: In terminator/src/platforms/windows.rs, introduced DEFAULT_ROLE_NAME_SEARCH_DEPTH=15 and modified find_element to first attempt a shallow depth‑15 search, falling back to depth‑50 if not found; find_elements defaults to the shallow depth.
change_trajectory: Single commit by cursoragent: implemented two‑phase search with depth constants.

review_signals.summary: Two-phase search applies timeout_ms separately to each phase, potentially doubling the total duration beyond the caller’s intended timeout.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor agent committed the optimized search.
cursor bugbot reviewed and flagged timeout mismanagement.
No further activity; PR closed without merge.
